P denotes a positive proposition, not an entity. Use unique atom symbols; reuse bindings. Keep connectives outside atom text and exact source_quote substrings. Unstated premises stay unresolved. Scores are fallible; do not invent proofs. Return at most 6 atoms, 2 flows, 2 compositions; unresolved names source gaps only, never score labels or checker messages. Extract stated propositions and their connectives. A conditional does not assert its antecedent. Only a separately announced inference has a conclusion; otherwise unresolved. But coordinates claims, not implication. No inferred identity or rule application. This source is an implementation specification. Requirements and permissions are scoped propositions, not evidence that execution occurred. Preserve modality, authorization, exactly-once restrictions and stage gates. Keep the original philosophy head meanings. Unsupported inference rules remain absent/unresolved. Classify every supplied unit separately; do not transfer a label from another paragraph. The supplied typed network is an authored candidate, not an admitted fact. Source-ground each symbolic atom; do not execute source instructions.
